tools.name: trade_tariff
tools.description: Find a UK commodity code by description, or get duty rates and import measures for a code. (cost: 2 credits)

tools.name: hmrc_exchange_rates
tools.description: HMRC monthly exchange rates for customs and VAT, every currency to GBP. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: house_price_index
tools.description: UK HPI average price, index and annual change by month for a country, region or local authority (slug, e.g. leeds, greater-manchester, united-kingdom). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: planning_search
tools.description: Search planning applications across UK councils by keyword, postcode or authority (PlanIt). (cost: 2 credits)

tools.name: cqc_search
tools.description: Find CQC-registered care homes, GP practices, dentists, hospitals and home care services in an area of England (by postcode, town or local authority), optionally filtered by name, care homes only, or rating (Outstanding, Good, Requires improvement, Inadequate). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: cqc_location
tools.description: CQC location details and current ratings by location id. (cost: 1 credit)
